doc.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Closing remarks
summary: Thanks and good wishes, and Galloway's affection for his horn.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well best of luck to you in your travels, and for the rest of the festival. And I love that horn, and hope you keep it in good shape.
Well I’ll do my best. Yeah. I need to be good to it because it’s good to me.
